notes: Course page states the programme is generally taught in English; modules in German are available in higher semesters and do not make German a teaching language of the programme. DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester None'; the THA semester contribution (approx. 180 EUR per semester, 181.95 EUR) is not tuition. The deadline 15 July on the DAAD page is given without a year and is applicable to applicants from all countries, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. THA FAQ lists further possible documents (e.g., certificate of mandatory service, transcript for higher semesters, consent for minors) that are not extracted here.
